entries.title: Picked the game engine in a separate Claude chat
entries.body:
Before any code, a separate claude.ai conversation compared engines for a phone-first browser jam game. Outcome: **Phaser 3**, loaded from a CDN with no build step, which is what the first Claude Code prompt asks for.

*The full conversation hasn't been imported yet, and its date and time are still to be confirmed.*

entries.title: Created the GitHub repository
entries.body: Created `fischerq/ludumdare60` on GitHub with an initial README commit.

entries.title: Connected the repository to Netlify
entries.body:
Linked the GitHub repo to Netlify, so every push to `main` deploys the site. No build command; `netlify.toml` publishes the repo root as-is.

*Exact time not recorded.*

entries.title: Reviewed and merged pull request #1
entries.body: Merged Claude's first pull request (starter game, making-of log, plan-usage tracking) into `main`, which deployed it.
